name: Dribble Past The Defender
steps: Give the hammer to the defender.
Throw the tomato at the striker.
Drag the pregnant woman in front of the defender.
Set the defender’s shoes on fire.
Drag the photographers to the defender.
Drag the cheerleader to the defender.
Shine the light at the defender.
Drag the tornado to the defender.
Cover the defender with the bush.
Place the heart above the defender.
